text: Steenbarger: move to a daily trigger. Keep h1_close_above:bar_high and the committee buys the back-up I objected to: D below EMA9, H1 below EMA9 9<21, pos_in_day_range_pct 2.3 (C5). My clearing condition is close_above:pivot_high on D, a daily close at a fresh new high once the back-up ends. minervini's daily close above the prior day's high is the same timeframe; his 1.4x volume is his test, not mine (R5). Nothing new moved me; SUPPORT on the trend, W swing HH/HL above EMA9 9>21. Wrong if a daily close back below structure_shift_ref (C20).
